feeds.title: The EPIC Energy Blog
feeds.description: EPIC's energy blog discusses Energy and Climate Policy, Legislative updates, energy bills, and Climate commitments by major players in the industry. The Energy Policy Initiatives Center is a non-profit academic and research center at USD. EPIC integrates research and analysis, law school study, and public education, in the development of sustainable solutions that meet our future energy needs.

feeds.title: ETH Zurich Energy Blog
feeds.description: The Energy Blog at ETH Zurich brings together ETH Zurich programs on energy policy, science, technology, and business. The Energy Blog is hosted by the Energy Science Center (ESC) and run by a team of enthusiastic doctoral and post-doctoral researchers. It is a bottom-up initiative from the research community to serve society.

feeds.title: Global Energy Blog
feeds.description: A blog on the latest developments in global energy law and policy.

feeds.title: Energy Policy Update
feeds.description: Energy Policy Update blog about energy resources, energy policy, and their effects on society and the environment. From fossil fuels to renewable energy, electricity to natural gas and oil, this blog presents a look at the past, present, and future of energy. Our purpose through this blog site is to assist in the dissemination of information about energy policy and related issues

feeds.title: Energy and Policy Institute
feeds.description: Grab hot takes, opinions, and updates regarding Energy and the Policy surrounding it in the Federal as well as State Governments. The Energy and Policy Institute is a watchdog exposing the attacks on renewable energy and countering misinformation by fossil fuel interests. We provide communities with the information they need to hold corporations and policymakers accountable.

feeds.title: Climate And Energy Project » Climate And Energy Policy
feeds.description: Stay informed and aware of global environmental challenges through our regular updates on Climate and Energy Policy. The Climate and Energy Project is a Kansas-based non-partisan nonprofit driving practical solutions for an equitable transition to a clean energy future. We connect people, organizations, and ideas and facilitate critical thinking and community engagement.

feeds.title: Environmentality CPR India » Energy Policy
feeds.description: Discover more about India's energy challenges in posts tagged Energy Policy by Environmentality Center for Policy Research India. A leading public policy think tank from India, CPR is a non-profit, non-partisan institution dedicated to conducting research that contributes to the production of high quality scholarship, better policies, and a more robust public discourse.

feeds.title: Chester Energy & Policy » Energy Policy
feeds.description: Chester Energy & Policy provides expert insights into the rapidly developing worlds of clean energy, power utilities, and sustainable business practices. We stay on top of the latest trends in the world of energy, combined with expertise in the relevant technologies and markets, to deliver the business and policy intelligence you need.

feeds.title: Clean Energy » Energy Policy
feeds.description: This blog examines impactful and trending news and events happening in the Energy Sector and the federal policy around it. Our articles cover Clean transportation, Solar power, and more. The Southern Alliance for Clean Energy promotes responsible and equitable energy choices to ensure clean, safe, and healthy communities throughout the Southeast.

feeds.title: ISEP Blog
feeds.description: The ISEP Blog reviews and shares updates on the latest changes to the government's Energy Policy. Read articles with insights and opinions on climate change. At Initiative for Sustainable Energy Policy (ISEP), we work to develop policies that address environmental justice, while improving energy access and reductions in greenhouse gas emissions.
